title: Interfaith Prayer Gathering
description: A sacred time of shared prayer and reflection, welcoming all faiths and spiritual traditions. Come as you are.

title: Potluck & Conversation: Loving Thy Neighbor
description: Bring a dish to share and join us for an evening of food, fellowship, and open-hearted conversation across faith traditions.

title: Midsummer Celebration of Light
description: An outdoor ceremony honoring the solstice with readings, music, and candlelight from members of our diverse faith communities.

title: Council Monthly Meeting
description: Open monthly meeting of the Ojai Interfaith Council. Community members welcome to attend and share.
